title: SN74HC08N Quad 2-Input AND Gate Hardware Verification
description: Construct and test a live SN74HC08N CMOS logic circuit using exact physical components: 1k resistor, red LED, battery/power supply, and jumper wires.

steps.title: Insert SN74HC08N IC Across Center Channel
steps.instruction: Push the 14-pin SN74HC08N across the center divider gap: Pin 1 in E10, Pin 7 in E16, Pin 14 in F10. Notch facing left toward column 1.

hints.missing: Seat the 14-pin SN74HC08N chip straddling the center divider gap.
hints.wrong_position: Ensure Pin 1 is at E10 and Pin 14 is at F10. Both rows of pins must straddle the center channel.
hints.reversed: Check the orientation: the notch/dot must point left toward column 1.

steps.title: Wire IC Power (+VCC) and Ground (GND)
steps.instruction: Connect Pin 14 (F10) to the (+) power rail with a red wire, and Pin 7 (E16) to the (-) ground rail with a black wire.

hints.missing: Connect Pin 14 (F10) to (+) rail and Pin 7 (E16) to (-) rail.
hints.wrong_position: Red jumper must connect F10 (Pin 14) directly to the (+) power rail.

steps.title: Insert Output Indicator LED (Gate 1 Output)
steps.instruction: Insert the red LED: Anode (longer leg) in D12 (connected internally to Pin 3 at E12), and Cathode (shorter leg) in D13.

hints.missing: Insert the red LED into holes D12 and D13.
hints.wrong_position: LED anode must be in D12 (sharing column 12 with Pin 3) and cathode in D13.
hints.reversed: Reverse the LED: the longer leg (anode) must face D12 toward Pin 3.

steps.title: Place 1k Resistor & Ground Return
steps.instruction: Insert the 1k resistor (Brown-Black-Red-Gold): one leg in C13 (connected to LED cathode) and the other in C20. Connect C20 to (-) rail with a jumper.

hints.missing: Place the 1k resistor between hole C13 and C20.
hints.wrong_position: Resistor must connect column 13 (LED cathode) to column 20.

steps.title: Wire Input Jumpers (1A & 1B)
steps.instruction: Insert two input jumper wires into E10 (Pin 1 / 1A) and E11 (Pin 2 / 1B). The free ends will be connected to (+) or (-) rails (or Arduino D2/D3).

hints.missing: Insert input jumpers into E10 (Pin 1) and E11 (Pin 2).
hints.wrong_position: Input A jumper must seat in hole E10, and Input B jumper in E11.

steps.title: Verify SN74HC08N AND Gate Truth Table
steps.instruction: Apply 0s and 1s to inputs 1A and 1B. Verify LED is OFF for (0,0), (0,1), (1,0) and turns ON only for (1,1).

hints.missing: Verify all connections are secure before running the electrical truth table test.
